Maya (Support): Hi team — BrightPath reports intermittent 503/504s on POST /v1/embeddings for large batched requests (~2.4MB). They attached logs showing "upstream read timeout" and "stream reset by peer". Can someone triage? (thread_ts=6168000123)
BrightPath (Customer): Started yesterday afternoon. Small requests are fine. Using python SDK with ~12 concurrent workers. Batches of ~50 short texts (~45 tokens each). We see 503s then cascading 504s; retries are piling up and tokens are billed. Blocked.
Maya (Support): Copy. Can you share SDK version, region, auth method, and a minimal repro? Also suggested temporary backoff and reduce concurrency.
BrightPath (Customer): SDK v1.4.2, region=us-west1, auth=bearer token rotation. Repro:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os, json
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
with open('batch.json') as f:
    payload = json.load(f)  # array of 50 strings, ~2.4MB total
for i in range(8):
    resp = c.embeddings.create(input=payload)
    print(i, resp.status_code)
```
They see 200 most of the time, then bursts of 503/504s.
Jun (Eng): @Priya @Luca - can we check LB and edge proxy logs for us-west1 and any auth fanout spikes? Suspect token-validation fanout + large initial frames causing stream resets.
Priya (Infra): Looking now. I see a spike in connections and a bump in request size distribution around 2024-07-18T16:42Z for that tenant. Edge proxy logs show "http2: stream closed" and some 502/504. No global region outage.
Luca (SRE): Also seeing auth-service fanout for that tenant during same window — many validation calls from concurrent workers due to token rotation. Could be coordination storm.
Jun (Eng): Embeddings endpoint uses streaming path (KV cache priming). Large request bodies + many concurrent streams can exhaust HTTP/2 initial window on some edge nodes and trigger resets. Short-term fixes: client reduce batch size (<2MB) and reduce concurrency, add jittered backoff. Server-side mitigation: increase initial window and header size limits for affected nodes, add backpressure on auth fanout.
Maya (Support): Passed mitigation steps to customer: set concurrency to 4, batch <2MB. They need throughput; asked for permanent fix ETA.
Priya (Infra): I implemented a targeted edge config change to increase HTTP/2 initial window and max header size for the tenant on a subset of nodes. Change id cfg-20240718-wnd1. Applied to 3/12 us-west1 nodes as a canary.
OpsBot: cfg-20240718-wnd1 deployed to 3/12 nodes (us-west1). Canary checks enabled.
Luca (SRE): Early telemetry: error rate for tenant on patched nodes dropped from ~7% to ~1.3%. Unpatched nodes still ~6-8%. Looks promising.
Jun (Eng): I'll draft a runtime PR to add per-tenant initial window config and auth fanout backpressure. That will be a safer long-term fix.
Maya (Support): Customer update sent: limited config change reduced errors, please retry with original concurrency for 10 minutes and report. Also recommended SDK pattern: jittered exponential backoff and concurrency cap until fix is rolled out.
BrightPath (Customer): Retried — much better, errors down but occasional 504s remain. Please keep us CC'd on permanence plan and release notes. Thanks.
Jun (Eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2713 (adds tenant window sizing + auth backpressure hooks). Requesting review. Planning canary QA tonight.
Priya (Infra): Rollout plan: expand config to 30% -> 60% -> 100% of us-west1 nodes over ~36h if telemetry stays healthy. Final tuning maintenance window: 2024-07-20 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Luca (SRE): I captured BrightPath's payload and will run load tests against canary nodes tonight to validate no regressions.
Maya (Support): Shared rollout schedule and mitigation steps with customer, set expectation: permanent fix ETA ~1 week (canary + full rollout). Will follow up after full rollout.
BrightPath (Customer): Appreciate the quick action. We'll hold concurrency at 4 for now and monitor. Please CC on PR/release notes.
Maya (Support): Closing provisional ticket for now; will reopen if they see regressions after rollout. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
